findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected: any route to Math.random in src/bots or src/advice is flagged. Actual: globalThis.Math.random() lints clean there (Math.random() and Math['random']() are flagged). Also, because the derivation moved to src/engine/bot-random.ts, the seed derivation itself sits outside the guarded folders; runtime checks show it uses no ambient entropy.
findings.fix: Optionally add a globalThis.Math restriction to the bot-determinism guard; consider covering src/engine/bot-random.ts with the guard in a later task.

findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected (A-3, by design): client decideBot defaults seed to 0. Actual: a future caller that omits the seed silently gets a constant stream; the only production caller passes turn.seed (confirmed in Chromium: all 42 posted seeds are derived).
findings.fix: None required now; consider making the client seed parameter required once the locked TASK-3.6 test can be updated.

summary: All 10 SPEC items PASS. Seed derivation independently reproduced from a Python reimplementation on 300 own (code, seat, k) triples; derivation is independent of time, Math.random, performance, crypto and the deck stream; user decisions and extra stats fields don't change bot requests or actions. In the real app (Chromium) only {id,kind,seed,style,view} crosses to the worker and every seed matches D-1; no replay code or code word is posted. Lint guard fires on all specified sources in src/bots and src/advice and not in src/engine or on allowed code. Playtest byte-identical to base. npm test, lint, typecheck, e2e and CI green. 11/11 product mutants killed. Recorded deviation (src/engine/bot-random.ts, structural generator type) is sound. Two LOW findings, no blocking findings.
